fichas.title: Water Sport, Marinas: Marine Engineering Works
fichas.summary: Reference on marina coastal protection and marine structures, including breakwaters, sheet-pile walls, dolphins, banks, quays, floating pontoons, cranes, and slipways. It emphasizes durable materials, protection from wave action and corrosion, and access for pedestrians and service vehicles.
uses: Protect marinas from wave impact, suction, and swell
Provide boat mooring and coastal protection
Provide pedestrian access and landside access for cranes
